begin MagnusLine1

short doonce

if(GetDistance, Player <= 256)
	if(doonce == 0)
		Player->say  "vo\Sotha\Magnus1.mp3""Ah, Illusion, one of the most subtle schools. It changes perception, not reality, you will never be able to change what is or is not, only what seems to be. But, what if perception IS reality? Why, you could be a god. Something worth pondering."
		set doonce to 1
	endif
endif

end

		set doonce to 1
	endif
endif

end

They are immortal, and their memories stretch endlessly. If you use wise and courteous, you may survive. Never suppose that any being is completely under your thrall."

begin MagnusLine6

Begin mazedbandEnd_Script

short button
short messageOn
short reset
short OnPcEquip

;if ( MenuMode == 1 )
;	Return
;endif


if ( OnPCEquip == 0 )
	set reset to 0
endif

if ( reset == 1 )
	return
endif

if ( OnPCEquip == 1 )
	if ( reset == 0 )
		Set OnPCEquip to 0
		MessageBox "Use the Mazedband to teleport where?" "Vivec" "Mournhold" "Sotha Sil" "Nowhere"
		if ( GetJournalIndex TR_SothaSil == 100 )
			set messageOn to 2
		else
			set messageOn to 1
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( messageOn == 1 )

	set button to GetButtonPressed

	if ( button >= 0 )
		set messageOn to 0
	endif

	;vivec
	if ( button == 0 )
		playsound "conjuration hit"
		Player->PositionCell 12, 219, -501, 0 "Vivec, High Fane"
		set reset to 1		

	;mournhold
	elseif ( button == 1 )
		playsound "conjuration hit"
		Player->PositionCell 0, -478, -645, 0 "Mournhold Temple: High Chapel"
		set reset to 1		

	;sotha sil
	elseif ( button == 2 )
		playsound "conjuration hit"
		Player->PositionCell 3985, 776, 12432, 0 "Sotha Sil, Dome of Sotha Sil"
		set reset to 1
		return

	elseif ( button == 3 )
		set reset to 1
		return

	endif

endif

if ( messageOn == 2 )

	set button to GetButtonPressed

	if ( button >= 0 )
		set messageOn to 0
	endif

	;vivec
	if ( button == 0 )
		MessageBox "You feel a powerful force interrupt the Mazed Band's spell and pull you toward Mournhold."
		playsound "conjuration hit"
		Player->PositionCell 0, -478, -645, 0 "Mournhold Temple: High Chapel"
		set reset to 1		

	;mournhold
	elseif ( button == 1 )
		MessageBox "You feel a powerful force interrupt the Mazed Band's spell and pull you toward Mournhold."
		playsound "conjuration hit"
		Player->PositionCell 0, -478, -645, 0 "Mournhold Temple: High Chapel"
		set reset to 1		

	;sotha sil
	elseif ( button == 2 )
		MessageBox "You feel a powerful force interrupt the Mazed Band's spell and pull you toward Mournhold."
		playsound "conjuration hit"
		Player->PositionCell 0, -478, -645, 0 "Mournhold Temple: High Chapel"
		set reset to 1
		return

	elseif ( button == 3 )
		set reset to 1
		return

	endif

endif


End

begin NI_looping_creature

short  initDone
float   xLimit
float   xStart
float   xNow

;get starting position & set limit
if ( initDone == 0 )
   set xStart to getPos Z
   set xLimit to xStart - 1000 ;assuming that the scene is 5000 units long
   set initDone to 1
endIf

;move the scener item
moveworld Z, -300
set xNow to getPos Z

;loop back to start when the end is reached.
if ( xNow < xLimit)
   set xNow to xLimit + 1000
   setPos Z xNow
endIf

end

begin pocket_cabalscript

if(OnDeath == 1)
	set pocket_deadcount to (pocket_deadcount + 1)
	set pocket_fightstage to 1
	if(pocket_deadcount == 1)
		Player-> Say "vo/Sotha/cabal_4.wav" "My word. You actually used guile. Unexpected, but not unsalvageable. At least once you've died here I can dine on your artifacts. You really do carry a lot of them."
	endif
	if(pocket_deadcount >= 5)
		set pocket_fightstage to 3
		set sotha_deadbegin to 2
		ExplodeSpell, "Restore Mage"
		if(sotha_slumdeadcount >= 15)
			Journal SSE_slums 50
		else
			Journal SSE_slums 55
		endif
	else
		Cast, "Restore Mage", Player
	endif
	Disable
endif
end

begin pocket_Float

float  	timer
float	swingTime
float	swingSpeed
float	startAngle

;set startAngle to GetStartingAngle, x
	if(pocket_deadcount >= 5)
		disable
		return
	endif


if ( MenuMode == 0 )

	set swingTime to 1
	;set swingSpeed to 30

	set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )

	;rotate up
	if ( timer < swingTime )

		Rotate x,2

	;rotate down

	elseif ( timer < (swingTime * 3) )

			Rotate x, -2

	;up again
	elseif (timer < (swingTime * 4 ) )
		Rotate x, 2

	;reset timer to zero
	else
		set timer to 0
		SetAtStart

	endif

endif

end Float

begin Sotha_Alma2

;script on Alamexia who appears and talks

short state
float timer
float timer2
float timer3
short teleportstate
short bosstate
short lightning
short stormcount
short OnPCHitMe

if ( menuMode == 1 )
	return
endif

if ( OnDeath ==1 )
	Journal, TR_SothaSil, 100
	set AlmalexiaDead to 1
	set bosstate to 0
	StreamMusic "Victory.mp3"
	Return
endif

if( bosstate >= 1)
	if(lightning == 0)
		set timer2 to (timer2 + GetSecondsPassed)
		if(timer2 > 15)

			if(teleportstate == 0)
				if(bosstate >= 2)
					PlaceAtMe, "_alma_explosion1", 1, 1, 1,
					if(bosstate >= 3)
						PlaceAtMe, alm_verminous, 1, 1, 1
					endif
				endif
				PlaceAtMe, _alma_explosion3, 1, 1, 1
				PositionCell, 7750, 1102, 12432, 0, "Sotha Sil, Dome of Sotha Sil"
				PlaySound "conjuration hit"	
				set timer2 to 0
				set teleportstate to 1
				Return
			endif

			if(teleportstate == 1)
				if(bosstate >= 2)
					PlaceAtMe, "_alma_explosion1", 1, 1, 1,
					if(bosstate >= 3)
						PlaceAtMe, alm_verminous, 1, 1, 1
					endif
				endif
				PlaceAtMe, _alma_explosion3, 1, 1, 1
				PositionCell, 495, 1102, 12432, 0, "Sotha Sil, Dome of Sotha Sil"
				PlaySound "conjuration hit"
				set timer2 to 0
				set teleportstate to 2
				Return
			endif

			if(teleportstate == 2)
				if(bosstate >= 2)
					PlaceAtMe, "_alma_explosion1", 1, 1, 1,
					if(bosstate >= 3)
						PlaceAtMe, alm_verminous, 1, 1, 1
					endif
				endif
				PlaceAtMe, _alma_explosion3, 1, 1, 1
				PositionCell, 4035, 565, 12432, 0, "Sotha Sil, Dome of Sotha Sil"
				PlaySound "conjuration hit"	
				set timer2 to 0
				set teleportstate to 0
				Return
			endif

		endif
	endif
	if(GetHealth <= 1500)
		if(bosstate < 3)
			PlaySound "conjuration hit"	
			PlaceAtMe, _alma_explosion3, 1, 1, 1
			PositionCell, 15040, -960, 7746, 0, "Sotha Sil, Dome of Sotha Sil"	
			set lightning to 1
			SetHealth, 3000
			set bosstate to (bosstate + 1)
		endif
	endif	
endif

if(lightning == 1)
	set timer3 to (timer3 + GetSecondsPassed)
	if(timer3 > 5)
		PlaySound "Thunder0"
		PlaceAtPC, "_alma_explosion1", 1, 128, 0
		set timer3 to 0
		set stormcount to (stormcount + 1)
	endif
	if(stormcount == 10)
		PositionCell, 4035, 565, 12432, 0, "Sotha Sil, Dome of Sotha Sil"
		PlaceAtMe, _alma_explosion3, 1, 1, 1
		PlaySound "conjuration hit"	
		set stormcount to 0
		set lightning to 0
	endif
endif

if( GetPos, Z <= 11520.000)
		PositionCell, 4035, 565, 12432, 0, "Sotha Sil, Dome of Sotha Sil"
		PlaceAtMe, _alma_explosion3, 1, 1, 1
		PlaySound "conjuration hit"	
endif


if ( GetJournalIndex SSE_Endgame >= 20 )
	return
endif

if ( sotha_state == 0 )
	disable
	"sotha alma appear effect2"->disable
	return
endif

if ( state < 100 )
	if ( OnPCHitMe == 1 )
		StopCombat Player
		set OnPCHitMe to 0
	endif
endif

if ( state == 0 )
	if ( GetDistance, Player < 240 )
		DisablePlayerControls
		enable
		PlaySound "conjuration hit"
		"sotha alma appear effect2"->enable
		set state to 10
	endif

elseif ( state == 10 )
	if ( timer < 3 )
		set timer to ( timer + getsecondspassed )
	else
		"sotha alma appear effect2"->disable
		if ( SayDone == 1)
			Say "vo\misc\tr_almaend_1.mp3" , "Nerevarine. Here it ends. This Clockwork City was to be your death. You were to be my greatest martyr! The heroic Nerevarine, sacrificing all to protect Morrowind from the mad Sotha Sil. But you live! You live!"
		endif
		set timer to 0
		SetHealth 3000
		set state to 20
	endif

elseif ( state == 20 )
	if ( SayDone == 1)
		Say "vo\misc\tr_almaend_2.mp3" , " Fear not. I will tell the tale myself when this is done. I will tell my people how with your dying breath you proclaimed your devotion to me, the one true god. Your death will end this prophecy and unite my people again under one god, one faith, one rule by my divine law. The puppet king will lay down his arms and bow to my will. Those who do not yield will be destroyed."
		SetHealth 3000
		set state to 30
	endif


elseif ( state == 30 )
	if ( SayDone == 1)
		Say "vo\misc\tr_almaend_3.mp3" , "The Mazed Band has allowed me to travel to this place. Here, I slew Sotha Sil. Here, I summoned the Fabricants to attack Mournhold. I will be the savior of my people! I alone will be their salvation!"
		SetHealth 3001
		set state to 40
	endif

elseif ( state == 40 )
	if ( SayDone == 1)

		if ( GetDeadCount, vivec_god > 0 )
			Say "vo\misc\tr_almaend_4a.mp3" , "But I smell the blood of gods on your hands, Nerevarine. Vivec was a fool. I'm sorry I wasn't there to see his death. But Sotha Sil...he always thought himself our better, shunning us, locking himself in this hole. He spoke not a word as he died. Not a whisper. Even in death, he mocked me with his silence! But I think you will scream, mortal. For now, you face the one true god."
		else
			Say "vo\misc\tr_almaend_4b.mp3" , "None may stand in my way. Not you, and certainly not Vivec. He is a poet, a fool. I will deal with him when I have finished with you. And Sotha Sil...he always thought himself our better, shunning us, locking himself in this hole. He spoke not a word as he died. Not a whisper. Even in death, he mocked me with his silence! But I think you will scream, mortal. For now, you face the one true god"
		endif
		SetHealth 3000
		set state to 100

	endif

else ( state == 100 )
	if ( SayDone == 1)
		if ( timer < 1 )
			set timer to ( timer + getsecondspassed )
		else
			EnablePlayerControls
			SetHealth 3000
			setfight 100
			StartCombat, Player
			set timer to 0
			PlaceAtMe, "act_Sotha_Music7", 1, 1, 1
			set state to -1
			set bosstate to 1
			Journal, SSE_Endgame, 20
		endif
	endif
endif



end

begin sotha_becomewatchman

short doonce 
short doonce2
short state
float timer
float timer2

if(beginWatch == 1)
	set timer to (timer + GetSecondsPassed)
	if(timer < 4)
		MoveWorld, Z, -100
	else
		set state to 10
	endif
	if(state == 10)
		set timer2 to (timer2 + GetSecondsPassed)
		if(doonce == 0)
			FadeOut, 4
			PlaySound "FabBossAlive"
			Player-> Additem "sotha_boots" 1
			Player-> Additem "common_robe_01" 1
